tools.name: invoiceflow_whoami
tools.description: Check which InvoiceFlow account this key belongs to and that the key works. Call this first; it is the cheapest way to fail early.

tools.name: invoiceflow_create_client
tools.description: Create a customer record. A client is required before an invoice can be created. Returns the new client id.

tools.name: invoiceflow_list_clients
tools.description: List existing clients. Use this before create_client to avoid making duplicate customer records.

tools.name: invoiceflow_create_invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT invoice for an existing client. Amounts are INTEGER CENTS: unitPrice 25000 means $250.00, not $25,000. Do not send totals - the server derives subtotal and total from the line items. Does not email anyone.

tools.name: invoiceflow_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their status and totals. Invoices belonging to other accounts are not visible and return as absent, not as errors.

tools.name: invoiceflow_get_invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice by id, including line items and derived totals.

tools.name: invoiceflow_share_invoice
tools.description: Get the payable Stripe Checkout link for an invoice. This is what you give a human so they can actually pay. Does not email anyone.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: invoiceflow_share_invoice · Private data: invoiceflow_create_client, invoiceflow_list_clients · Public sink: invoiceflow_create_invoice, invoiceflow_share_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: invoiceflow_share_invoice · Private data: invoiceflow_create_client, invoiceflow_list_clients · Public sink: invoiceflow_create_invoice, invoiceflow_share_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
